Ordinary Windows computer unavailable; actual browser checks are on development machine. Mobile deferred.
Some older appearance recipes intentionally omit live props/materials. Legacy migration remains explicit; ambiguous records reject rather than guess.
Independent consumer has no workbench DOM/draft or author-tool dependency. Runtime/API reuse is verified only for named records, not every body and outfit combination.
